reviews.quote: The Acer Chromebook Plus 516 is a large Chromebook with a vibrant and sharp display and great performance, though its ultra-large size limits its portability.
The Acer Chromebook Plus 516 GE proves that Chromebooks can fill a special niche, with faster processing and a vivid, high-refresh-rate display. Editors' Choice.
Basic Chromebook with a big screen and battery - there is nothing wrong with the Chromebook Plus 516 to prevent a recommendation.

standouts: The only 16-inch Chromebook Plus stocked in Canada — big-screen desktop-replacement niche at a reasonable $849.99
design_philosophy: Acer's 516 takes the Chromebook Plus formula to desktop-replacement size: a 16" 16:10 panel, a fast Core 5 U CPU, and 512GB storage for people who want a simple family/secondary machine with a big display. It trades portability and screen colour quality for size and storage, and sits above the value tier without a discount to justify it.
